items.text: FROM NATURE TO CULTURE TO NATURE

In this research project, i question the boarder between culture and nature, try to figure out what these words mean to me and can mean in general and learn through a series of experiments that are all in the end displayed in the installation you can see above.

The installation itself is another experiment. It is a participatory installation, that lets people interact and rearrange the individual pieces. Like that people can figure out what feels more natural and cultural.
I thook a lot of pictures figuring out what and why something feels more like nature - and I painted photos to see if time was involved in the feeling.
I also experimented with material and how this choice affects the feelings i get.
Here i tried building a sculpture with material from the forest and letting the form be decided by how i carried the materials in my hand.

In the end i noticed that my thoughts and my intend change a lot about my perception of objects and work. I tried to express that with the frames in my installation. The frames are also free to be moved around and can change other experiments though framing them. The also can be empty and be an object for themselfs. 

This project asks a lot of phylosofical questions. Through the installation I try to share my process of reflecting and thoughts about these big topics in general.
